claude.rationale: This is a Plan of Liquidation: the customer-facing properties (T4) are sold asset-by-asset to multiple unnamed buyers ("sold individually to unnamed buyers"), while the operating/disposition processes (T5) and the managing organization/people (T6, the Advisor/Hines) explicitly "remained constant and un-transferred throughout." Thus T4 crosses the ownership boundary to buyers without the producing/operating processes transferring alongside it — a documented product-vs-process mismatch driving gap_45=1; the slice states no transitional-services agreement was structured, so gap_mitigated=no. Because T5 and T6 both stay with the same Advisor/Hines organization and neither transfers, there is no T5-without-T6 mismatch, so gap_56=0. The entity is to be dissolved (T1/T2/T3 terminate), with no successor intent identified.

gemini.rationale: The transaction is a liquidation where the customer-facing assets (properties, T4) are sold individually to various buyers (1-N). However, the operating processes (T5) and personnel (T6) are provided by an external Advisor and do not transfer with the assets, resulting in a structural mismatch (gap_45 = 1). No transitional services agreement was structured to bridge this gap.

No transitional-services agreement with an outside operator was structured.
